title: 全固态电池
Solid-state batteries
deck: 成分验证、样品生产与客户交付，各自需要什么证据？
Composition tests, sample production and customer delivery require different evidence.
about: “固态”描述电解质体系，并不直接回答电芯中是否含锂、能量密度有多高，或是否已进入量产。本专题把检测指标与工程事件分开。涉及 Donut Lab 的题目反映各自创建者的规则；受委托的测试结果只覆盖报告实际测量的项目。

Solid-state refers to the electrolyte system; it does not establish lithium content, energy density or production readiness. This topic separates measurements from engineering milestones. Commissioned testing covers the measurements actually reported.

title: 室温超导
Room-temperature superconductors
deck: 从独立复现实验，到常压器件的商业应用。
From independent replication to commercial ambient-pressure devices.
about: 零电阻、磁响应、相变和样品成分共同构成核对线索，悬浮视频本身不足以替代完整表征。LK-99 的历史题目还展示了“有人做了复现实验”“实验支持超导”和“商品采用超导体”之间的区别。这里保留各题不同的温度、压力、时间边界和取消状态。

Zero resistance, magnetic response, transitions and sample composition need joint review; levitation alone is insufficient. LK-99 contracts distinguish replication attempts, successful replication and commercial adoption. Contract-specific definitions and cancellations remain visible.
questions: 题目要求的是实验发表，还是成功复现？
Does the contract ask for publication or successful replication?

条件市场的前提失败后，是 No 还是取消？

title: 碳捕集与 MOF
Carbon capture & MOFs
deck: 把材料供应、捕集过程和实际运行区分开来看。
Distinguish material supply, capture processes and operating deployment.
about: MOF 的开放孔隙可以通过节点与配体化学进行调节，但过程表现还取决于成型、湿度、再生和循环条件。BASF 与 Svante 的 CALF-20 供应合作是可查的产业资料，不等于某个装置已经实现公告中的所有目标。本次 Manifold 检索未找到可核验的 Svante、Atoco 或 MOF 专用产业事件；下列相关市场分别涉及生物分子与矿物风化，不被标成 MOF 赔率。

MOF pores are chemically tunable, while process performance also depends on shaping, humidity, regeneration and cycling. The BASF–Svante CALF-20 supply agreement is documented industrial evidence, not proof of every deployment target. This Manifold search found no verified Svante, Atoco or MOF-specific industrial contract. Related protein and mineral-weathering contracts below are not labelled MOF odds.

summary: 这是后续复现判定题，平台判 No；原规则引用另一市场，不能只凭标题的年份理解它。
A later replication contract resolved No; its dependence on another market makes the title’s year insufficient.
checklist: 先查看关联市场和创建者澄清。
Inspect the dependent contract and creator clarifications.
核对零电阻、排磁及物相证据。
Check zero resistance, magnetic response and phase identity.
不把独立论文出现或阻值突降当成成功复现。
Do not equate a paper or resistance drop with successful replication.

label: 关联规则待核对
Dependent rule needs review
detail: 规则引用另一年份市场。
Resolution depends on another-year market.

events.originalTitle: Will another lab post results testing superconductivity (or lack of superconductivity) in LK-99 within a week?
title: 是否出现独立团队的 LK-99 实验论文？
Would an independent team publish an LK-99 experimental paper?
rules: 原规则判断是否由另一研究组在 arXiv 发布 LK-99 实验论文，结果可以支持也可以不支持超导。
The rule concerns an experimental arXiv paper by a separate group, whether its findings support superconductivity or not.
interpretation: “出现复现实验”与“成功复现超导”是两个不同事件；保留这个题目以显示它们的区别。
A replication experiment appearing is distinct from superconductivity successfully replicating.

summary: 预测的是有没有独立团队发布实验论文，平台判 Yes；实验可以得到负结果，不要求证实超导。
Resolved Yes on whether an independent experimental paper appeared; the paper could report a negative result.
checklist: 确认独立团队和 arXiv 实验论文的条件。
Check independent authorship and the experimental-paper criterion.
区分实验研究与纯计算讨论。
Distinguish experimental work from computation alone.
读论文结论；该题 Yes 不能改写成“LK-99 是超导体”。
Read the result; Yes here does not mean LK-99 is superconducting.

events.originalTitle: Will a commercially available device incorporate a room-temperature, ambient pressure superconductor by 2030?
title: 2030 年前是否出现常压高于 0 °C 的超导商品？
Will a commercial device use ambient-pressure superconductivity above 0 °C before 2030?
rules: 要求可商业获得的设备使用常压、高于 0 °C、无需主动冷却的超导体。
Requires a commercially available device using ambient-pressure superconductors above 0 °C without active cooling.
interpretation: 这是商业器件事件，不限 LK-99。高于 0 °C 也与另一个市场的 0–30 °C 范围不同。
This device contract is not limited to LK-99; above 0 °C differs from another contract’s 0–30 °C range.

summary: 预测 2030 年前出现可商业获得的特定超导器件；门槛比“发现一种材料”更靠后。
This asks about a commercially obtainable qualifying device before 2030, a later milestone than material discovery.
checklist: 同时核对常压、高于 0 °C 和无需主动冷却。
Check ambient pressure, above 0 °C and no active cooling together.
确认商品实际可获得，排除只有实验室演示的样品。
Verify commercial availability rather than a lab-only demonstration.
查器件所用材料和实际运行条件。
Identify the material and actual device operating conditions.

events.originalTitle: Will a commercially available device incorporate a room-temperature, ambient pressure superconductor by 2025?
title: 2025 年前超导商品的历史预测
Historical prediction of a superconducting commercial device before 2025
rules: 与后续器件市场采用相近的常压、温度和冷却条件，时间边界为 2025 年前；平台判定 No。
Uses similar pressure, temperature and cooling conditions to the later device market, with a pre-2025 horizon; resolved No.
interpretation: 保留历史期限，不能用后续发生的结果改写当年市场，也不能把判定 No 解释为技术永远不可行。
The historical horizon is preserved. Later events cannot rewrite it, and No does not mean permanent technical impossibility.

summary: 这是较早截止的同类商品题，平台已判 No。它记录当时期限内的结果，而非宣判超导商品永不出现。
An earlier commercial-device contract resolved No. It records its deadline, not permanent technological impossibility.
checklist: 按旧题的时间窗口解释历史价格。
Interpret prices within the original deadline.
核对商业可得性和冷却条件，而非只看超导报道。
Check availability and cooling conditions, not merely superconductivity news.
把后续 2030 题作为另一市场阅读，不拼接两条价格曲线。
Read the 2030 contract separately rather than splicing histories.

events.originalTitle: Conditional on LK-99 replicating, will a RTSC be used commercially by 2026?
title: 以 LK-99 复现为前提的商业应用预测
Commercial adoption conditional on LK-99 replication
rules: 这是条件市场；原规则规定，若所依赖的 LK-99 复现市场判 No，则本市场不适用。
This is conditional: if the referenced LK-99 replication contract resolves No, this contract becomes inapplicable.
interpretation: 平台已取消结算。取消不等于 No，历史曲线也不应改成 0%。
The platform cancelled this market. Cancellation is not No, and history must not be replaced with 0%.

summary: 这是有前提的商业应用题，已取消。其前置复现市场判 No 后，后续问题按规则变为不适用。
This conditional commercialization contract was cancelled after its replication premise failed.
checklist: 先核对依赖的复现市场，而非直接解释末笔百分比。
Review the prerequisite replication contract before interpreting the last price.
将取消与 No、0% 以及商业失败分开。
Distinguish cancellation from No, zero probability and commercialization failure.
历史概率仅表示条件尚未失效时的交易判断。
Read historical prices in the context of the then-applicable condition.

events.originalTitle: Alphafold involved in a SOTA C02 direct air capture method by mid 2026 ?
title: AlphaFold 是否参与领先的空气碳捕集方法？
Would AlphaFold contribute to a leading direct-air-capture method?
rules: 原题关注 2026 年中前的 AlphaFold 或其后继技术参与；平台已判定 No。
The question concerns AlphaFold or a successor contributing before mid-2026; the platform resolved No.
interpretation: 原描述对“领先方法”的量化定义有限；这不是 MOF 专用市场，也不能从这次判定推出蛋白质路线没有研究价值。
The description gives limited quantitative meaning to leading performance. This is not MOF-specific, and settlement does not rule out protein-based research.

summary: 预测 AlphaFold 或后继技术是否参与领先的空气捕集方法，已判 No；不是判断酶能不能捕集 CO₂。
Resolved No on AlphaFold involvement in a leading DAC method, not on whether enzymes can capture CO₂.
checklist: 找到模型实际用于哪一步设计的可核验记录。
Identify documented model use in a specific design step.
查空气 CO₂ 条件和完整过程表现，不能以烟气实验替代。
Check atmospheric-CO₂ conditions and full-process performance, rather than flue-gas results.
原规则的“领先”口径有限，比较效率必须回到原条件。
The source’s leading-method definition is limited; compare performance under explicit conditions.

label: 规则细节不足
Limited rule detail
detail: “领先”的验收标准未充分量化。
Leading performance is not sufficiently quantified.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.

events.originalTitle: Anthropogenic olivine-based direct air capture of CO2 at >10^9 tons CO2/year before 2050?
title: 橄榄石碳移除能否达到每年十亿吨量级？
Will olivine-based carbon removal exceed one billion tonnes per year?
rules: 原题要求人为增加的橄榄石路线 CO₂ 捕集量，在 2050 年前超过每年 10⁹ 吨。
The question requires human-induced olivine-based CO₂ capture above 10⁹ tonnes per year before 2050.
interpretation: 这是矿物风化相关市场，不是 MOF 市场；成交和参与者很少，展示原始数量，不把概率称为科学界共识。
This mineral-weathering contract is not a MOF market. Activity is thin; its probability is not described as scientific consensus.

summary: 预测 2050 年前人为橄榄石路线超过每年十亿吨 CO₂；只有两位参与者、两个采样点，无法支持细致走势判断。
This asks about >1 Gt CO₂/year from human-enhanced olivine before 2050. Two participants and two observations cannot support a detailed trend.
checklist: 核查是年度净大气移除量，而非矿物投放量或累计量。
Check annual net atmospheric removal, not mineral deployment or cumulative totals.
核算溶解、空气—海洋交换、过程排放和额外性。
Account for dissolution, air–sea exchange, process emissions and additionality.
同时查生态风险与监测数据；理论潜力不代表实际规模。
Review ecology and monitoring alongside scale; theoretical potential is not deployment.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.

name: Donut Lab
Donut Lab
intro: 电动交通技术企业；本专题涉及其电池产品主张、受委托测量和可能的车辆应用。
An electric-mobility technology company; these contracts concern its battery claims, commissioned measurements and possible vehicle use.

name: 芬兰 VTT 技术研究中心
VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
intro: 提供研究与测试服务；此处链接其对 Donut Lab 委托测量范围的官方说明。
A research and testing organization; its linked statement explains the scope of Donut Lab’s commissioned measurements.

name: QuantumScape
QuantumScape
intro: 固态锂金属电池技术开发企业；相关事件关注陶瓷隔膜技术进入具体电芯格式和样品生产。
A solid-state lithium-metal battery developer; the linked contract concerns separator integration and sample production.

name: PowerCo
PowerCo
intro: 大众集团电池业务企业；此处关注其 Unified Cell 格式与 QS 技术结合的确认条件。
Volkswagen Group’s battery company; the event concerns confirmation of QS technology in its Unified Cell format.

name: Toyota
Toyota
intro: 汽车制造商；相关预测把固态电池、整车销售、续航与充电要求写在同一事件中。
An automaker; the listed contract combines solid-state chemistry, vehicle sales, range and charging requirements.

name: Apple
Apple
intro: 消费电子产品企业；相关事件关注 iPhone 的电池技术与产品发布。
A consumer-electronics company; this contract concerns iPhone battery technology and product release.

name: BASF
BASF
intro: 化工与材料企业；CALF-20 资料涉及 MOF 吸附剂放大和商业供应。
A chemicals and materials company; the CALF-20 sources concern MOF scale-up and commercial supply.

name: Svante
Svante
intro: 开发固体吸附剂碳捕集技术，采用结构化过滤器；本页区分材料供应与装置实际运行。
A solid-sorbent carbon-capture developer using structured filters; supply and operating deployment are distinguished here.

name: 曼彻斯特大学
The University of Manchester
intro: 相关研究机构；具体作者、合作机构和实验条件以链接论文为准。
A related research institution; consult the paper for complete authors, affiliations and experimental conditions.

name: Google DeepMind
Google DeepMind
intro: AlphaFold 的开发机构；相关碳捕集题目预测的是该技术的参与，而非某种 MOF 的表现。
The AlphaFold developer; the carbon-capture contract concerns technology involvement rather than a MOF’s performance.

ETH Zürich
intro: LLZO 界面评论的作者机构；研究关注无机电池材料与固态界面。
An author institution of the LLZO Comment, working on inorganic battery materials and interfaces.

name: Empa 瑞士联邦材料科学与技术研究所
Empa
intro: LLZO 界面评论的作者机构；以原文所列实验和计算讨论为范围。
An author institution of the LLZO Comment; consult the original for the reviewed experimental and computational scope.

name: 美国能源部
U.S. Department of Energy
intro: 提供超导临界条件与器件应用的基础解释；未为此处市场报价背书。
Provides scientific explanations of superconductivity and applications, separate from these market prices.

NOAA
intro: 开展海洋碳移除、碳酸盐体系与生态效应研究；公开说明测量和放大的未知项。
Researches marine carbon removal, carbonate chemistry and ecology, including measurement and scale-up uncertainties.

Sandia National Laboratories
intro: 碳酸酐酶纳米孔分离膜论文的合作机构之一，完整合作名单见论文。
One of the collaborating institutions on the carbonic-anhydrase membrane paper; full affiliations are in the paper.

name: 中国科学院物理研究所
Institute of Physics, CAS
intro: 开展凝聚态物理研究；所引 LK-99 工作检验杂相与输运异常的关系。
A condensed-matter research institute; the cited work investigates impurities and transport anomalies in LK-99.

name: Intertek 天祥集团
Intertek
intro: 提供检测、检验等服务；本页链接的是特定送检电芯组分的元素定量报告。
A testing and inspection provider; the linked report concerns specified submitted cell components.

name: 出光兴产
Idemitsu Kosan
intro: 能源与材料企业，与 Toyota 合作开发硫化物固体电解质及相关制造路线。
An energy and materials company collaborating with Toyota on sulfide electrolytes and manufacturing.

name: SuperPower
SuperPower
intro: 第二代高温超导线材供应商；本页将低温产品与常温市场条件区分。
A second-generation HTS conductor supplier; cryogenic products remain distinct from ambient-temperature contract conditions.

name: Saipem
Saipem
intro: 能源与工业工程企业，提供 CO₂ Solutions 酶法捕集等技术；没有据此认定其使用 AlphaFold。
An energy and industrial engineering company offering enzymatic CO₂ capture; no AlphaFold use is inferred.

name: Vesta
Vesta
intro: 从事沿岸增强风化研究的公益型企业；开展橄榄石试验与监测。
A public benefit corporation researching coastal enhanced weathering through olivine pilots and monitoring.

title: VTT：受委托测试的范围
VTT: scope of commissioned measurements
body: VTT 说明其接受委托，在实验室测量 Donut Lab 所提供电池的性能。核对时应回到具体报告：测了什么、由谁提供样品、哪些结论没有涵盖；测试机构名称不等于对企业全部产品主张的认证。

VTT describes commissioned laboratory measurements on customer-supplied batteries. Read each report for its measurements, sample provenance and scope; the institution’s name does not certify every product claim.

title: LK-99 的合成、表征与输运测量
LK-99 synthesis, characterization and transport measurements
body: 曼彻斯特大学相关研究的原始论文报告了合成、表征与输运测量，并未在其 LK-99 样品中观察到超导信号。结论适用于论文中的样品和方法；它与“是否出现独立实验论文”的市场可以同时成立。

The original study reports synthesis, characterization and transport measurements without observing superconductivity in its LK-99 samples. Its sample-specific finding can coexist with a Yes outcome on whether an independent experimental paper appeared.
citation: arXiv:2308.03823v2 (2023). DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.2308.03823. Full authors and affiliations are in the paper.

title: CALF-20：从吸附材料到供应合作
CALF-20: from sorbent to a supply agreement
body: Svante 公告与 BASF 签订 CALF-20 MOF 吸附材料商业供应协议，支持其结构化吸附过滤器路线。供应与制造规模是这一公告的重点；计划中的装置、未来产能和实际运行捕集量仍应分别核查。

Svante reports a BASF commercial supply agreement for CALF-20 MOF sorbent used in structured filters. Material supply and manufacturing are distinct from planned facilities, future capacity and measured operating capture.

title: BASF：MOF 生产与碳捕集用途
BASF: MOF production for carbon capture
body: BASF 的资料说明其 MOF 放大与生产工作及 Svante 合作关系。材料制造能力有助于讨论工程放大；若要比较过程成本、寿命或减排量，还需要对应装置和工况的独立数据。
BASF describes MOF scale-up and its Svante relationship. Manufacturing capability informs scale-up assessment; process cost, lifetime and avoided emissions require plant-specific operating data.

title: Intertek：送检软包电池组分的锂、钠定量
Intertek: lithium and sodium in submitted pouch-cell parts
kind: 实验室报告 · 企业公开的原文件
Laboratory report · original file published by customer
body: 报告分析一个电芯的阳极、阴极及集流体组分，未分析外包装。ICP-OES 得到 Li 3.4 ppm、Na 632 ppm（质量比）。这能回答送检组分的元素含量，不能直接证明全部量产电池具有相同配方；与市场的质量分数门槛比较时还须核对取样与分母。

ICP-OES measured one cell’s anode, cathode and current-collector parts, excluding its pouch. Reported lithium is 3.4 ppm w/w and sodium 632 ppm. These results concern submitted material, not every production cell; sampling and the mass denominator matter to the contract.

label: 报告范围
Scope
value: 1 个电芯的送检活性组分；不含外包装
Submitted active parts from one cell; pouch excluded

citation: Intertek Wilton, IWTN/W000020339RLM002。原文件由送检企业公开；公开日期依据另链接的企业披露。
Intertek Wilton, IWTN/W000020339RLM002. Original file published by the customer; public-release date follows the separately linked company disclosure.

title: VTT：DL6 电芯的质量与体积能量密度
VTT: gravimetric and volumetric energy density of cell DL6
body: VTT 对客户提供的一个 V1.5／DL6 电芯在 +25 °C、0.1C 放电条件下测得 409.3 Wh/kg 与 804.7 Wh/L。结果来自第二次放电。它不是快充循环寿命测试，也不直接确定电解质配方；这份报告不能回填成此前历史市场已在截止前达标的证据。

One customer-supplied V1.5/DL6 cell yielded 409.3 Wh/kg and 804.7 Wh/L at +25 °C and 0.1C discharge, calculated from the second discharge. This is neither a fast-charge lifetime test nor a chemistry identification. A later report cannot establish eligibility before an earlier contract deadline.
citation: VTT-CR-00391-26，Donut Battery V1.5 Energy Density Test。报告签发日不代表首次公开日。
VTT-CR-00391-26, Donut Battery V1.5 Energy Density Test. Report date is not treated as the first public-release date.

title: ETH Zürich／Empa：LLZO 与锂金属的界面问题
ETH Zürich / Empa: the LLZO–lithium interface
body: 论文讨论表面清洁和界面层如何影响润湿、界面阻抗与锂沉积／剥离。改善一个实验电池的界面，并不等于已经解决大面积薄片制造、装配和良率；文献也指出部分作用机理仍缺乏共识。它解释 LLZO 商业化题目的技术障碍，不提供某家工厂已达 1 GWh 的证据。

The Comment examines cleaning and interlayers in wettability, interface resistance and lithium plating/stripping, noting unresolved mechanisms. A laboratory interface improvement does not establish large-area manufacturing yield or a facility’s 1 GWh output.
citation: Communications Chemistry 7, 257 (2024). DOI: 10.1038/s42004-024-01350-9。作者机构：ETH Zürich、Empa。
Communications Chemistry 7, 257 (2024). DOI: 10.1038/s42004-024-01350-9. Affiliations: ETH Zürich and Empa.

title: QuantumScape：Eagle Line 关键设备安装
QuantumScape: installation of key Eagle Line equipment
kind: 企业原始公告 · 中试制造
body: 公司公告称已安装用于提高 QSE-5 电芯产量的关键设备，Eagle Line 结合 Cobra 隔膜工艺和自动化电芯生产。公告把它定位为中试线，以及未来许可伙伴放大的基础。它不是“PowerCo Unified Cell 格式样品已得到双方确认”的同义说法，也不代表已达到吉瓦时商业产量。

QS reports installing equipment for higher-volume QSE-5 production, combining Cobra separators and automation in a pilot line. It describes a basis for future licensee scale-up, not proof of a jointly confirmed PowerCo Unified Cell sample or gigawatt-hour commercial output.

title: Toyota／出光：从硫化物电解质到整车的三阶段路线
Toyota / Idemitsu: a three-stage sulfide-to-vehicle pathway
kind: 联合企业公告 · 研发与量产计划
body: 双方合作以硫化物固体电解质为重点：先完善材料和大型中试准备，再推进中试制造及车型开发，最后研究全面量产。材料软、易黏附有利于加工，但循环中的界面开裂与耐久性仍是工程问题。公告中的 2027–2028 目标是计划，不是客户已收车的记录。

The partnership focuses on sulfide electrolytes, progressing from material/pilot preparation to pilot manufacturing and vehicle development, then full-scale production studies. Interfacial durability remains an engineering issue. Its 2027–2028 target is a plan rather than a retail delivery record.

title: Toyota：区分液态电解质电池与固态路线的性能目标
Toyota: separate liquid-electrolyte and solid-state targets
body: 路线图同时讨论液态与固态方案。“约 1000 km”等整车目标还受车辆效率影响，快充目标则注明荷电状态区间。比较原市场的 1000 km 与少于 15 分钟条件，需要确认同一车型、同一电池路线和充电区间，不能把不同方案的最佳数字拼到一起。

The roadmap covers liquid and solid electrolytes. Range also depends on vehicle efficiency; charge-time targets specify a state-of-charge interval. The contract’s range and charging conditions must apply to the same vehicle and chemistry, not a mixture of targets from different programs.

title: Apple：当前电池原理说明与快充阶段
Apple: battery explanation and charging stages
body: Apple 的说明使用锂离子电池框架，并解释快充至约 80% 后转为较慢充电。快充、循环优化或更高能量密度本身都不能证明手机换用了固态电解质。判断这一市场要查具体发布产品的电池技术资料；这份说明不是对所有未来型号的承诺。

Apple explains lithium-ion charging, including a fast phase followed by slower charging around 80%. Faster charging and better endurance alone do not establish solid electrolytes. The market requires product-specific battery evidence; this general page does not promise every future model’s chemistry.

title: DOE：零电阻、排磁与临界条件
DOE: zero resistance, field expulsion and critical conditions
body: 超导体在临界温度以下可无直流电阻地传输电流，并呈现排磁行为；超过临界电流会破坏超导态。已经应用于 MRI 等装置的超导体并不因此满足“常压、0 °C 以上、无需主动冷却”的合同条件。材料发现与可销售器件是两道门槛。

Superconductors have zero DC resistance and field-expulsion behavior below critical conditions; excessive current destroys the state. Existing MRI applications do not satisfy a contract requiring ambient pressure, above 0 °C and no active cooling. Material discovery and a saleable device are separate milestones.

title: 中国科学院物理研究所：Cu₂S 杂相与电阻突变
Institute of Physics, CAS: Cu₂S impurities and resistance transitions
kind: 原始实验研究 · Matter / arXiv
body: 研究比较 Cu₂S 与含 Cu₂S 的 LK-99 样品，观测到类似超导转变的电阻变化和热滞后，却未观察到零电阻。论文提出，约 385 K 的硫化亚铜结构转变可以解释该类异常。这说明电阻曲线出现骤降，需要连同物相、磁性和测量下限一起判断。

The study finds resistance transitions and thermal hysteresis in Cu₂S and Cu₂S-containing LK-99, without zero resistivity. It attributes the anomaly to a structural transition around 385 K. A sharp resistance drop therefore needs phase, magnetic and measurement-limit checks.

title: Sandia 等机构：碳酸酐酶辅助的 CO₂ 分离膜
Sandia and collaborators: carbonic-anhydrase separation membranes
body: 研究将碳酸酐酶置于亲水纳米孔结构中，在论文条件下提高 CO₂ 分离通量和选择性。这证明酶可以参与分离材料设计；它不证明该方法使用了 AlphaFold，也不等同于已完成低浓度空气的工业碳移除。完整作者与合作机构见原论文。

Carbonic anhydrase confined in hydrophilic nanopores supports CO₂ separation under the paper’s conditions. This establishes an enzyme-based material approach, not AlphaFold involvement or deployed industrial direct-air removal. The paper lists all authors and collaborating institutions.
citation: Nature Communications 9, 990 (2018). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-018-03285-x。完整合作机构见原文。
Nature Communications 9, 990 (2018). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-018-03285-x. Full collaborating affiliations are in the paper.

title: Google DeepMind：AlphaFold 输出的是什么
Google DeepMind: what AlphaFold predicts
body: AlphaFold 用于预测生物分子结构及相互作用。结构预测可以为酶的实验设计提供起点，但催化速率、溶剂稳定性和捕集过程的能耗仍需实验或过程数据。仅在论文中使用一次模型，与原市场所说的“参与领先空气捕集方法”，不是相同证据门槛。

AlphaFold predicts biomolecular structures and interactions. That can guide enzyme experiments, but catalytic rates, solvent stability and process energy still require measurements or process data. A single model use is not the same as the contract’s leading-DAC criterion.

title: NOAA：海洋增碱与碳移除的测量边界
NOAA: measurement boundaries in ocean alkalinity enhancement
body: 海洋增碱改变海水化学，使其有能力吸收更多空气 CO₂；碱度变化与已经发生的净大气移除需要分别测量。NOAA 将可扩展性、成本、生态影响等列为研究问题。因此，橄榄石溶解、矿物投放量和每年净移除十亿吨并不是同一个量。

Ocean alkalinity enhancement increases seawater’s capacity to absorb atmospheric CO₂. Alkalinity change and realized net atmospheric removal require separate measurement. NOAA identifies scale, cost and ecological effects as research questions; mineral dissolution or deployment tonnage is not annual net carbon removal.

title: NOAA Fisheries：橄榄石的短期生态实验
NOAA Fisheries: short-term olivine ecology experiments
body: 短期实验观察到海水碱度和 pH 增加，未见浮游植物过量积累重金属；同时发现矿物带来的氮需要控制。报道明确保留长期生态效应的不确定性。这里的样品和实验范围不能外推成全球部署规模或长期安全结论。

The short-term experiment observed higher alkalinity and pH without excess heavy-metal accumulation in phytoplankton, while identifying nitrogen addition as a concern. Long-term effects remain unresolved. These experimental conditions do not establish global deployment or long-term safety.

title: Svante：Redwood 过滤器工厂的产能口径
Svante: what Redwood filter capacity measures
kind: 企业原始公告 · 制造设施
body: Svante 宣布 Redwood 过滤器制造设施完成调试，称其年产过滤器可支持最高约 1000 万吨 CO₂ 的年捕集能力。这是按过滤器用途表述的制造能力，不是工厂自身每年已经从空气移除了 1000 万吨。要核实减排或碳移除，需要下游装置的运行量、能源与永久封存记录。

Svante reports commissioning Redwood and describes annual filter output sufficient to support up to 10 million tonnes of annual CO₂ capture capacity. That is filter-manufacturing capacity, not CO₂ already removed by the factory. Downstream operation, energy and permanent-storage records are needed for removal claims.

title: SuperPower：已商业供应的 REBCO 超导线材
SuperPower: commercially supplied REBCO conductors
body: 公司供应第二代高温超导线材，官网说明的运行例子仍在 77 K、30 K、4.2 K 等低温条件下。“高温超导”是相对传统超导体的术语，并不表示高于 0 °C。该产品说明既有制造和应用链条，但不是 LK-99 被采用或原题常温商品条件已经实现的证据。

The supplier describes second-generation HTS conductors operating at cryogenic temperatures such as 77 K, 30 K and 4.2 K. High-temperature does not mean above 0 °C. Its product establishes an existing manufacturing chain, not LK-99 adoption or satisfaction of these ambient-temperature contracts.

title: Saipem：CO₂ Solutions 的工业酶法捕集路线
Saipem: industrial enzymatic capture with CO₂ Solutions
body: Saipem 介绍以碳酸盐溶剂和酶为基础的工业排放捕集技术，并讨论余热利用与过程集成。这是判断“酶法有没有工程应用”的一份企业资料。页面没有据此证明 AlphaFold 的参与，也没有将其定义为从空气中移除 CO₂ 的领先方法，不能替原题补齐这两个条件。

Saipem describes enzyme/carbonate-solvent capture of industrial emissions and process integration. It supplies industrial context for enzymes, without establishing AlphaFold involvement or leadership in direct air capture. Those extra contract conditions remain separate.

title: Vesta：橄榄石沿岸试验与监测
Vesta: coastal olivine pilots and monitoring
body: Vesta 的科学资料介绍沿岸增强风化试验，目标包括测量天然条件下的橄榄石溶解速率、碳移除效率与生态影响。公开试验说明路线在实地研究，并不等于已实现原题要求的每年十亿吨。公司提出的长期愿景与实际项目监测结果须分开读。

Vesta describes coastal trials studying olivine dissolution, carbon-removal efficiency and ecology. A field pilot shows research under natural conditions, not achievement of the contract’s annual gigatonne threshold. Ambition and measured project results remain separate.
